hypothesis_checks: GJR15.4 requires legal value-group vertices for admissible formal models;15.5 integral slopes and value-group constants.

GJR15.7 actually proves both directions for arbitrary Thuillier-harmonic functions, by a LOCAL edge/star rational-basis construction. It is not limited to a function already assumed R-PL. This does not prove arbitrary global subharmonic graph realization or a full obstacle envelope theorem.
GJR5.8/5.9 give local ordinary-neighborhood real-linear decompositions, not a blanket global decomposition into integral model functions.

GJR15.11 gives a decreasing NET of weakly smooth approximants for a general subharmonic function; its single piecewise-real-linear smoothing step has a decreasing sequence. CLD ordinal successor stages use sequences; a countable reduction for the whole net remains a separate new obligation.
GJR15.10 distinguishes ordinary smooth functions from weakly smooth harmonic tropicalizations; residue and potentially-P1 geometry hypotheses matter.
Thuillier3.4.2 uses directed finite subsets and Thuillier piecewise-linear lisse functions, rather than ordinary CLD smooth functions.
